cues: Enzymes are astonishingly efficient, and astonishingly specific: urease attacks urea and nothing else.
They work only in a narrow range of temperature, around body temperature, and of p H, because heat denatures the protein.
Yeast enzymes ferment rice for jaand and raksi, and Lactobacillus turns milk into dahi.
